Home.heroBody: Advanced CNC machining solutions from Taiwan. Gantry, double-column, multi-face and vertical machining centers built for large, heavy and demanding work.
Home.showcaseLede: One series from each category. Every name, type and figure comes from the 2026 catalogues.
Home.technologyBody: "It is the precise starting point for machine tools; it removes dependence on other machine tools and eliminates deviation from clamping force and thermal energy." Every KAO MING guideway is hand scraped before it ever cuts metal.
Home.factoryAlt: The KAO MING machining hall, with overhead crane

Home.companyBody: Founded in Fongyuan by Chang Gao-Ming and Chang Tsai Mei-Hsia, and building gantry, double-column, multi-face and vertical machining centres from a constant-temperature plant in the Central Taiwan Science Park.

Contact.label: Contact
Contact.title: Talk to KAO MING
Contact.lede: Headquarters is in the Central Taiwan Science Park, Houli. For a machine enquiry, the fastest route is a quote request — it reaches the sales team with your application already attached.
Contact.quoteBody: Tell us the workpiece, the material and the tolerance. Sales replies with the machine that fits and a price.
Contact.representativeBody: {agents} agents across {countries} countries and territories quote, install and service KAO MING machines locally.
Contact.plantNote: Where the machines are built and shipped from, and the address on KAO MING's own correspondence.
Contact.headOfficeNote: The registered address, in the district KAO MING has been in since 1974. It is the address on the contract, not the loading dock.

Technology.label: Technology
Technology.title: How a KAO MING machine is made accurate
Technology.lede: Accuracy in a machine tool is not a feature bolted on at the end. It comes from the surfaces the machine is built on and the way its axes carry load. Both are decisions KAO MING has written down.

ways.title: Box way or linear way
ways.lede: This is the choice that decides what a machine is good at. KAO MING builds both and states plainly what each is for — set side by side, because that is how the decision is actually made.

History.label: Company
History.title: Since 1968
History.lede: Ten milestones, from a rotary arm drilling bed workshop on Chung Cheng Road to a 25,000 m² constant-temperature plant in the Central Taiwan Science Park.
History.milestonesTitle: Ten events, as KAO MING states them
History.provenance: Years and milestones transcribed verbatim from kaoming.com, August 2026, and paired from the source page's own stored layout — which the Traditional Chinese page reproduces independently. The two locales differ on one figure: the 2008 plant is 25,000 m² in English and 40,000 m² in Chinese. Each is printed as KAO MING wrote it, pending their confirmation.

Factory.label: Company
Factory.title: Inside KAO MING
Factory.lede: The plant, photographed. Every image on this page is a real photograph of KAO MING's own facility.

machining.title: Machining
machining.copy: The machining hall, under overhead crane. Castings this size are moved by crane and cut in one setting — the reason the building is shaped the way it is.

assembly.title: Assembly
assembly.copy: A 168CE on the assembly floor. Assembly is where scraped surfaces meet and where a machine's accuracy is either achieved or lost.

parts.title: Parts
parts.copy: Inventory racks. KAO MING has built machines since 1968, and the parts to keep an old one running are part of what a buyer is buying.

shipping.title: Shipping
shipping.copy: The same 168CE, crated. Agents in 33 countries means most machines leave here in a box built for a sea container.

heritage.0: The Central Taiwan Science Park plant
heritage.1: The original headquarters in Feng Yuan

missing.body: The process journey has four more steps and KAO MING has supplied no photography for them. Captioning an existing photograph with a step it does not show would misrepresent the facility, so they are named here instead and stay unbuilt until real photography arrives.
